name: Shenzhen Microgate Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Microgate Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of passive electronic components and modules in China and internationally. The company offers power and signal inductors, EMI/EMC components, and customized magnetic products; transformers comprising solid-state, planar, LAN, wound low-power, wound high-power, and current transformers; RF components that include low-temperature co-firing ceramic and SAW devices; and bias tee module products.
